author: Original procedural geometry and original material maps generated in Blender4.3.2 for Viva Wewa
rights: Reference photos retained privately for observation; no reference photograph or copied mesh is embedded in source textures or export. Supplier catalogue variants are explicitly not certified RDC identity.
geometry_method: Directly stitched radial caps, five shaped openings, rounded aperture walls and open XR annular rim/hub-envelope profiles. Native analytic corner normals; constrained planar triangulation. No buffer repair, remesh or global Bevel in this candidate.
scope: Outer rim, five visible branches, partial annular outer hub wall. Central bearing/coupling web, internal seats, brakeplate, sprocket carrier, axle and tyre absent.
dimensions: All physical profiles and dimensions estimated except 17-inch nominal bead-seat conversion 431.8mm. Five branches observed on official RDC images. Width45mm is a candidate envelope, not certified bead-seat width.
material: Original deterministic periodic height/noise seed16002; 512-square normal and ORM PNG. Estimated silver finish and micrometre relief; no measured alloy/coating/roughness identity. Smoother internal envelope is not certified machined/friction surface.
export_note: Blender warned that multiple texture-image nodes were considered for sampler selection. Both source nodes use default linear/repeat; actual GLB embedded PNG pixels and material roles were independently read and match author images (material-buffer-check).
